name: bld4_sqrt_two_rec_defect_tsum_lower
statement: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : a 0 = 0) (h : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 1) = Real.sqrt (2 + a n)) : Real.pi ^ 2 / 3 - Real.pi ^ 4 / 180 ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, (2 - a n)
closed: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : a 0 = 0) (h : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 1) = Real.sqrt (2 + a n)), Real.pi ^ 2 / 3 - Real.pi ^ 4 / 180 ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, (2 - a n)
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld2_sqrt_two_rec_defect_summable, Mathlib2.ana_sqrt_two_rec_closed_form and Mathlib2.ana_sin_ge_cubic_of_nonneg: termwise 2 − a_n ≥ π^2/4^(n+1) − π^4/(192·16^n) (closed form + cubic sine bound, as in the pointwise estimate). The right side is a difference of geometric series with sum π^2/3 − π^4/180; bld2_sqrt_two_rec_defect_summable supplies summability of the left side so tsum comparison (hasSum_le / tsum_le_tsum) applies. Improves the bound 8/3 of bld3_sqrt_two_rec_defect_tsum_bounds.
